(: REQ: LANG-801 LANG-802 LANG-803 LANG-804 :) xquery version "3.1"; declare namespace ex = "http://example.com/ns"; (: outer (: nested :) still a comment :) declare function local:greet($name as xs:string, $times as xs:integer) as xs:string { string-join(for $i in 1 to $times return concat("Hello, ", $name, "!"), " ") }; let $doc := doc("people.xml") for $p in $doc//person where $p/@age > 30 and fn:count($p/email) gt 0 order by $p/name descending return if (contains($p/name, 'it''s')) then local:greet($p/name, 2) else <person name="{ $p/name }"/>
